raw.query: WITH h100_val AS (SELECT o.img AS n, o.avg_expected AS operator_ms, m.meas_encode AS physical_vllm_ms, ROUND((100*(o.avg_expected-m.meas_encode)/m.meas_encode)::numeric,3) AS pct_diff FROM (SELECT img, AVG(vision_expected_ms) avg_expected FROM provenance.measured_request WHERE vision_expected_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY img) o JOIN (SELECT num_images, AVG(encode_ms) meas_encode FROM provenance.vllm_vision_encode GROUP BY num_images) m ON o.img=m.num_images), rtx5090_val AS (SELECT p.n_images AS n, p.mean_ms AS aic_ms, c.mean_ms AS vllm_ms, ROUND((100*(c.mean_ms - p.mean_ms)/p.mean_ms)::numeric, 3) AS pct_diff FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn p JOIN provenance.collector_encoder_fn c ON p.n_images = c.n_images AND p.image_px = c.image_px WHERE p.engine = 'aic' AND p.note ILIKE '%silicon service%' AND p.image_px = 448 AND p.is_valid AND c.engine = 'vllm' AND c.image_px = 448 AND c.is_valid) SELECT 'H100' AS platform, n, operator_ms AS val1, physical_vllm_ms AS val2, pct_diff FROM h100_val UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'RTX5090' AS platform, n, aic_ms AS val1, vllm_ms AS val2, pct_diff FROM rtx5090_val ORDER BY platform, n;
raw.observed: H100: N=1 (operator 14.414ms vs physical 14.417ms, diff -0.021%), N=4 (operator 55.525ms vs physical 55.466ms, diff 0.106%); RTX5090: N=1 (AIC 8.162ms vs vLLM 8.031ms, diff -1.611%), N=64 (AIC 316.369ms vs vLLM 333.611ms, diff 5.450%), maximum difference is 12.509% at N=57.
raw.claimed: The collected encoder operator agrees with physical measurement, a matched-engine check validates the composed forward against the serving engine's own vision tower (vLLM).
raw.evidence: Simulated H100 expected operator latency matches physical vLLM measurements within 0.11%. The RTX5090 matched-engine check validates the composed model against vLLM within 12.5% across the entire N=1..64 serving regime, staying inside the reported +/-12.8% shaded band.
